items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: This boy, Grounds, took a long time to finish it, but he finished it, boy.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, neighboring man, boy, that thing was hell. Boy, all them guys could write. I'm not forget the sweet and lovely. This boy, Grounds, took a long time to finish it, but he finished it, boy. That was a pretty boy, that was a pretty peak boy, that man wrote.
